cast_device_unreachable.title: {name} has no Cast connection
cast_device_unreachable.description:
Home Assistant has failed {count} times in a row to reach {name} ({entity_id}) on {host} port 8009, so no announcement can be delivered to it. Discovery may still list the device.

Next action: power-cycle the device. If it comes back and fails again, check that TCP port 8009 from Home Assistant to {host} is allowed; a firewall that permits mDNS but not the Cast channel produces exactly this.

Last error: {error}

This issue clears itself when a delivery or probe to {name} succeeds.

cast_group_spans_subnets.title: Speaker group {name} spans subnets
cast_group_spans_subnets.description:
The group leader is {leader_ip} and the members sit on {subnets}. Group playback and announcements to the group depend on multicast and unicast traffic between those subnets, and the leader can move to another subnet on election.

Next action: if announcements to the group are unreliable, place all members on one subnet or allow the Cast ports (TCP 8008 to 8009 and the dynamic group port, UDP 32768 to 61000) between the subnets.

This issue clears itself when the members share a subnet.

internal_url_automatic_multihomed.title: Internal URL is automatic on a host with several network adapters
internal_url_automatic_multihomed.description:
Home Assistant currently advertises {host} to cast devices, chosen automatically from these networks: {adapters}. If the adapter election changes, announcements move to another address without warning.

Next action: in Settings, System, Network, set the Home Assistant URL (internal) explicitly to the address your cast devices can reach.

This issue clears itself once the internal URL is pinned or the host has one adapter.

stale_cast_device.title: {name} has not been seen for {days} days
stale_cast_device.description:
The cast device {name} is registered in Home Assistant but discovery has not reported it since {last_seen}. Automations that target it will fail silently.

Next action: if the device was replaced or removed, submit this repair to delete the registry entry. If it still exists, power-cycle it and check that mDNS reaches Home Assistant.

This issue clears itself when the device is discovered again.

tts_fetch_failed.title: {name} cannot fetch announcements from Home Assistant
tts_fetch_failed.description:
{name} ({entity_id}, {host}) accepted the last {count} announcements and then reported that it could not fetch the audio from {url_source}. Nothing was heard.

Next action: from a device on the speaker's network, open Home Assistant's {url_source} in a browser. If it does not load, a firewall or VLAN rule between the speaker's subnet and Home Assistant is blocking it. If it loads, check that `internal_url` points at an address the speaker can reach, not a hostname it cannot resolve.

Last error: {error}

This issue clears itself when a delivery to {name} succeeds.

tts_template_error.title: An announcement template failed to render
tts_template_error.description:
The message template sent to {entity_id} through `cast.announce` did not render, so no announcement was made.

Template: `{template}`

Error: {error}

Next action: a bare `| int` or `| float` on a sensor that is `unknown` or `unavailable` is the usual cause; give the filter a default, for example `| int(0)`, or guard with `is_number`.

This issue clears itself the next time the same template renders.

data_description.ignore_cec: A comma-separated list of Chromecasts that should ignore CEC data for determining the active input. This will be passed to pychromecast.IGNORE_CEC.
data_description.uuid: A comma-separated list of UUIDs of Cast devices to add to Home Assistant. Use only if you don’t want to add all available cast devices.

data_description.probe_enabled: Every interval, each idle speaker plays a quarter second of silence served by this Home Assistant instance. The TTS outcome sensor shows the result, so a speaker that cannot reach Home Assistant is reported before an announcement is missed.
data_description.probe_interval: Seconds between probe cycles; the floor is 60.
data_description.group_probe_enabled: Speaker groups are probed through their leader. Turn off if a group buffers forever when probed (pychromecast issue 1197).
data_description.probe_video_devices: Off by default: launching the media receiver on a Chromecast with a display can turn on the connected TV through CEC.
